observation.visible_scene: A soldier in camouflage uniform and helmet lies prone in tall, dry grass, shouldering a scoped rifle whose objective lens cap is flipped open. The foreground grass is heavily out of focus; the background shows blurred trees under a bright, overexposed sky. The rifle points toward the right of the frame.
visible_changes: Out-of-focus grass blades in the foreground sway and shift continuously across the clip, indicating wind.

The soldier, rifle, scope, and background trees all drift gradually toward the right side of the frame over time, consistent with a slow camera pan/drift to the left (or slight repositioning of the subject).
The soldier holds a steady prone aiming posture throughout, with only minor body and head adjustments; no recoil, muzzle flash, or smoke appears, so no shot is visibly fired within the segment.
The open flip-up scope cap remains in the same raised position relative to the scope the whole time.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the rifle is fired before or after this excerpt, and what the target is.
The full extent of the environment and the soldier's complete body position beyond the cropped view.
uncertain_details: The rightward drift of subject and background could be camera motion, subject movement, or a combination; background evidence is too blurred to confirm cleanly.
Subtle focus/exposure changes between frames are hard to attribute to the camera versus the wind-blown grass.
